messages.author: 473c4ce8ca8f75f2
messages.subject: color gradient in hexbin plots
parts:
Good morning

If I run, e.g.

ggplot(data = diamonds, aes(carat, price)) + geom_hex()

It produces what I thought it would produce - a scatterplot of the diamonds data, with hexagonal binning. But the color scheme seems a little off.
Not the colors that it uses, but where it uses them. It looks like there is only one hexagon at the highest level (over 7000 or so) and a huge number at
the lowest level.

Can this be adjusted?

Peter

PS I took the "looking at data" course last week - it was excellent! I am now playing some more with some of the examples Hadley used.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: color gradient in hexbin plots
parts:
Hi Peter,

One way is to log transform the mapping between count and colour:

ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price)) +
geom_hex(aes(fill = log10(..count..)))

Hadley
